hooks.command: HOME_DIR="${REKOL_HOME:-$MEMORY_HOME}"; if [ -n "$HOME_DIR" ] && [ -f "$HOME_DIR/MEMORY.md" ]; then echo "[rekol] $HOME_DIR loaded — consult MEMORY.md, when/*.md, topics/*.md, or run rekol search"; cat "$HOME_DIR/MEMORY.md"; else echo '[rekol] memory home not configured (set REKOL_HOME)'; fi
